name: nick-personal-marketplace
description: Nick's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace featuring OMT and other productivity tools

plugins.name: omt
plugins.description: OMT - One Man Team: Your personal development squad powered by Agent-First workflow with 5 autonomous agents

plugins.name: viz
plugins.description: Visual output for chat and browser — inline code-shape visuals (viz-inline) plus markdown/Mermaid HTML rendering (viz-render)

plugins.name: apple-podcasts
plugins.description: Fetch Apple Podcasts episode audio download URLs via iTunes API and RSS feeds

plugins.name: context-flow
plugins.description: [Experimental] Contract-driven development pipeline with human-in-the-loop decision gating — agents defined by Context + Goal + Tools, not roles

plugins.name: spiral
plugins.description: [Experimental] Spiral — narrow a vague question into an implementation-sized goal, one layer at a time: diverge into the decisions a layer can settle, you answer a round of them, probes walk what you left open, converge into a plan or milestone, a prototype builds one throwaway thing when a walk cannot answer it, then dig another layer, go back up, or stop; hands the goal to /cf and ships no code

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Architecture spec library — invariants and forward-looking interface contracts as verifiable, sliceable entries that reach workers through their briefs, plus a CONTEXT.md domain glossary

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: Architecture Decision Records lifecycle management with MADR 4.0, a three-condition warrant test, and cross-reference consistency enforcement

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Browser automation with agent-browser CLI, Playwright test generation, and debug-to-test workflows

plugins.name: hook-guard
plugins.description: One-stop hook setup — detect project environment, generate git pre-commit and commit-msg scripts with security checks and code quality gates

plugins.name: fizzy
plugins.description: Interact with Fizzy via the Fizzy CLI — manage boards, cards, columns, comments, steps, reactions, tags, users, notifications, pins, webhooks, and account settings

plugins.name: obsidian-workspace
plugins.description: Obsidian Workspace — personal vault productivity: quick capture to journal, long-form notes, and project management via Obsidian CLI; /obw:pm splits a spec into blocking tickets; /issue opens a Claude Mod pane that lists a view of the project's dashboard, draws Mermaid as text diagrams, and offers an optional open-in-browser card view through viz

plugins.name: pi-dispatch
plugins.description: [Experimental] Offload heavy work to Pi's cheap/fast models — builder + reviewer subagents over pi-agent.sh/pi-dispatch.sh background workers, so Claude only writes briefs and reads summaries, saving tokens

plugins.name: wizard
plugins.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through the steps only a human can perform — dashboard logins, credential capture, CI secret writes, one-off migrations

plugins.name: diagnose
plugins.description: Diagnose a confirmed cause of a bug and leave one failing test on a branch to read from, without applying the fix

plugins.name: deepen
plugins.description: Survey a codebase for deepening opportunities — shallow modules, leaking seams, interfaces that are hard to test through — and hand the candidates to viz as a Mermaid report

plugins.name: omp-quota
plugins.description: [Experimental] Every omp provider's remaining quota in-session — a /quota band above the prompt, /quota refresh, and a toast when a provider worsens from ok (Claude Mod; needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1)

plugins.name: calendar
plugins.description: [Experimental] Upcoming Google Calendar events in-session — /cal toggles a band above the prompt with the next 7 days, /cal N for N days (Claude Mod; needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 and the claude.ai Google Calendar connector)
